description: Collect the result of a Luw.ai generation that was still processing (tools return a processing_url when a job outlasts their wait). Waits for the job to finish (up to the server's wait limit) — call again if it's still running. Free; never re-run a generation instead.

processing_url.description: The processing_url returned by a generation tool.

source_image.description: The source returned with that processing_url (the job's input image), so the result is shown before and after.

wait.description: Wait for completion (default true). false = check once and return immediately.

name: luw_get_result
title: Get generation result
